title: Selftest walkthrough
share: Acme Reports puts revenue, active users and churn on one page, and its report search filters as you type.

intro.title: Acme **Reports**
intro.sub: A tiny app used to check the video pipeline.

items.v: Nobody can answer: are we growing?

beats.say: Are we growing? Acme Reports answers that on one page, and this tiny version tests the whole video pipeline.
Most teams keep their numbers in several tools, and none of them answers that one simple question.
Maya, where should I look first?
Right here on the overview tab, where four numbers show how the week went.
Revenue comes first, and below it the trend. The email and the key on the next card are blurred.
And who is actually using the product?
This table shows it. It is wider than the screen, so we scroll it sideways to see every column.
On the reports tab, the search filters the list with every letter you type.
One report is left, the cancellations deep dive, so the answer is a single click away.
That is everything the pipeline does in one short run.
